description: This file contains utility functions related to prime numbers, including functions to find the next greater prime and the lower prime relative to a given number. It also defines a static array of prime numbers between 2 and 3299.

methods.name: ocudu::prime_greater_than
methods.description: Returns the smallest prime number greater than the input n.

methods.name: ocudu::prime_lower_than
methods.description: Returns the largest prime number less than the input n.
